new_content.name: Gravestone
new_content.how_to_obtain: Crafted: stone bricks, stone bricks, stone bricks in the top row; stone bricks, any sign, stone bricks in the bottom row.

new_content.name: Grave
new_content.how_to_obtain: Created automatically at your death location.
new_content.notes: Holds your items and XP; right-click opens a GUI, shift+right-click with an empty hand does a quick pickup (default config).

new_content.name: Emptied Grave
new_content.how_to_obtain: Left after a grave has been emptied.

new_content.name: Grave Compass
new_content.how_to_obtain: Given on death when give_death_compass is enabled (default true).

mechanics.title: Protection and expiry (mod defaults)
mechanics.description: Other players cannot open a grave for 900 s (15 min); it self-destructs after 1800 s (30 min) and drops its items if drop_items_on_expiration is true. Pack ships no config, so defaults should apply.

mechanics.title: Experience
mechanics.description: Default is to store 100% of XP points.

mechanics.title: Placement
mechanics.description: Searches up to 8 blocks from the death spot for a free location and can shift position on failure; no per-player grave limit by default.

commands_and_keybinds: /graves player <player> - list another player's graves (permission universal_graves.list_others)
universal_graves.teleport permission allows teleporting to any grave
getting_started: On death, follow the Grave Compass or run /graves to find your grave, and open it before the timer expires.
editor_notes: Values come from the README's documented defaults/examples; verify against generated config/universal-graves/config.json in-game. Uses Polymer so vanilla clients work.
name: Universal Graves
summary: On death, your items and experience are stored in a grave block at the death location instead of scattering, with a protection timer against other players and a grave compass that points to it. It works server-side, so no client install is needed.
